tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Backdrop of the engine's ca-canvas mockup wrapper. Not used in the app or on the cover.

tokens.name: app
tokens.usage: The cool ground behind the floating sidebar and cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the floating sidebar, the bottom tab bar, header chips, menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a secondary button; table header row.

tokens.name: surface-faint
tokens.usage: Group rows in tables.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of list rows, gym session heads, menu items and table rows.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the chosen item in a list (an exercise, a week).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks: the gauge, target bars, training-effect bars, the season timeline; the skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: spark-rest
tokens.usage: Resting bars of a sparkline and empty days in a trend.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Tiles inside cards (meters, stats), key-session cards, neutral badges.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Normal range behind a chart line: a light violet wash.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders of chips, session cards, date blocks and buttons.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers and chart gridlines inside a card.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, gauge ticks, chart band edges, rest-week blocks in the season strip, a hovered marker chip.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of checkboxes, radios and the off switch: 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, values, names. The navy-black of the original Kunto.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Numeric cells, secondary button labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Resting nav items, labels, chip text, meta lines that matter.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, uppercase labels, axis ticks, sources. Darker than the original's #7C7F96, which failed 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The training violet: primary buttons, the current nav item's icon, chart lines, today's marker, focus rings.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Current nav item, activity icon chips, the Today and Optional badges, top-set chips.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Violet text: links, the current nav item, training-effect verdicts, top sets.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Good: meter segments, the freshness dot, the good readiness zone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of good badges and the freshness pill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft: Done, Balanced, Good, Best yet.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Engine badge dots, which Kunto hides. Too light for marks in light mode (2.3:1): use warning-strong for anything that must be seen.

tokens.name: warning-strong
tokens.usage: Caution fills that must read at 3:1: low readiness, flagged points, the peak block.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of caution badges.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-soft and caution values: Low, Above optimal, Over plan.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Poor: the readiness gauge below 25, missed sessions. Always with the word.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of critical badges.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Text on critical-soft: Poor, Missed.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral chart marks that must read at 3:1: awake time in sleep bars, a compare line, muted bars.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Strongest step of the violet ramp: anaerobic, deep sleep, heavy gym days, goal blocks.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Middle step: aerobic, REM, medium gym days.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Lightest step: light sleep, light gym days, base blocks.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs.

styles.name: type-score

styles.name: type-verdict
styles.usage: The readiness verdict and the training-status phrase.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels: eyebrows, sources, stat labels, weekday in date blocks. Always uppercase via CSS, never typed in capitals.
